     1→// ─── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     2→
     3→export type SystemName = "CCTV" | "ACCESO" | "VOCEO" | "INCENDIO" | "CANALIZACION" | "CABLEADO" | "GENERAL";
     4→
     5→export interface CameraEntry {
     6→  type: string;
     7→  qty: number;
     8→  hasPoE: boolean;
     9→}
    10→
    11→export interface CctvConfig {
    12→  cameras: CameraEntry[];
    13→  nvr: { qty: number; bays: number; storageTB: number; disksPerBay: number };
    14→  avgDistanceMeters: number;
    15→  licenses: number;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export interface AccessConfig {
    19→  doors: number;
    20→  readerType: string;
    21→  controllers: number;
    22→  turnstiles: number;
    23→  magneticLocks: number;
    24→  exitButtons: number;
    25→  touchlessButtons: number;
    26→  avgDistanceMeters: number;
    27→  softwareLicenses: number;
    28→}
    29→
    30→export interface SpeakerEntry {
    31→  type: string;
    32→  qty: number;
    33→}
    34→
    35→export interface PagingConfig {
    36→  speakers: SpeakerEntry[];
    37→  amplifiers: { qty: number; watts: number };
    38→  zones: number;
    39→  gateways: number;
    40→  avgDistanceMeters: number;
    41→  bluetoothSpeakers: number;
    42→}
    43→
    44→export interface FireConfig {
    45→  smokeDetectors: number;
    46→  heatDetectors: number;
    47→  manualStations: number;
    48→  strobes: number;
    49→  hornStrobes: number;
    50→  coDetectors: number;
    51→  panels: { qty: number; loops: number };
    52→  annunciators: number;
    53→  avgDistanceMeters: number;
    54→}
    55→
    56→export interface EstimateFactors {
    57→  wasteFactorCable: number;
    58→  wasteFactorConduit: number;
    59→  verticalDrop: number;
    60→  rackAllowance: number;
    61→  indirectFactor: number;
    62→  utilityFactor: number;
    63→}
    64→
    65→export interface LineItem {
    66→  partida: string;
    67→  code: string;
    68→  description: string;
    69→  unit: string;
    70→  quantity: number;
    71→  unitCost: number;
    72→  totalAmount: number;
    73→  system: SystemName;
    74→  category: string;
    75→  isEstimated?: boolean;
    76→}
    77→
    78→export interface SystemBreakdown {
    79→  materials: number;
    80→  labor: number;
    81→  engineering: number;
    82→  services: number;
    83→  lineItems: LineItem[];
    84→}
    85→
    86→export interface CalculationResult {
    87→  systems: Record<string, SystemBreakdown>;
    88→  subtotalMaterials: number;
    89→  subtotalLabor: number;
    90→  subtotalEngineering: number;
    91→  subtotalServices: number;
    92→  subtotalDirect: number;
    93→  subtotalIndirects: number;
    94→  subtotalUtility: number;
    95→  grandTotal: number;
    96→  lineItems: LineItem[];
    97→}
    98→
    99→export interface PriceItemRecord {
   100→  id: string;
   101→  sku: string;
   102→  system: string;
   103→  category: string;
   104→  brand: string;
   105→  model: string;
   106→  description: string;
   107→  unit: string;
   108→  unitCost: number;
   109→  performance: number;
   110→  active: boolean;
   111→}
   112→
   113→// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   114→
   115→function round2(n: number): number {
   116→  return Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
   117→}
   118→
   119→function matchPriceItem(
   120→  items: PriceItemRecord[],
   121→  system: string,
   122→  category: string,
   123→  keywords: string[]
   124→): PriceItemRecord | null {
   125→  const lowered = keywords.map((k) => k.toLowerCase());
   126→  return (
   127→    items.find((item) => {
   128→      if (item.system !== system) return false;
   129→      if (category && item.category !== category) return false;
   130→      const desc = item.description.toLowerCase();
   131→      return lowered.some((kw) => desc.includes(kw));
   132→    }) ?? null
   133→  );
   134→}
   135→
   136→function makeLineItem(
   137→  idx: number,
   138→  systemPrefix: string,
   139→  system: SystemName,
   140→  code: string,
   141→  description: string,
   142→  unit: string,
   143→  quantity: number,
   144→  unitCost: number,
   145→  category: string = "Equipo",
   146→  isEstimated = false
   147→): LineItem {
   148→  return {
   149→    partida: `${systemPrefix}.${String(idx).padStart(2, "0")}`,
   150→    code,
   151→    description,
   152→    unit,
   153→    quantity: round2(quantity),
   154→    unitCost: round2(unitCost),
   155→    totalAmount: round2(quantity * unitCost),
   156→    system,
   157→    category,
   158→    isEstimated,
   159→  };
   160→}
   161→
   162→function sumLineItems(items: LineItem[]): { materials: number; labor: number; engineering: number; services: number } {
   163→  let materials = 0;
   164→  let labor = 0;
   165→  let engineering = 0;
   166→  let services = 0;
   167→  for (const item of items) {
   168→    const amt = item.totalAmount;
   169→    if (item.category === "Mano de Obra") labor += amt;
   170→    else if (item.category === "Servicio") services += amt;
   171→    else if (item.category === "Ingeniería") engineering += amt;
   172→    else materials += amt;
   173→  }
   174→  return { materials: round2(materials), labor: round2(labor), engineering: round2(engineering), services: round2(services) };
   175→}
   176→
   177→// ─── System Calculators ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   178→
   179→export function calculateCCTV(
   180→  config: CctvConfig,
   181→  factors: EstimateFactors,
   182→  priceItems: PriceItemRecord[]
   183→): SystemBreakdown {
   184→  const items: LineItem[] = [];
   185→  let idx = 1;
   186→
   187→  // Total camera count
   188→  const totalCameras = config.cameras.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.qty, 0);
   189→
   190→  // Cable calculation for cameras
   191→  const cableLength = round2(
   192→    (config.avgDistanceMeters + factors.verticalDrop + factors.rackAllowance) * totalCameras * (1 + factors.wasteFactorCable)
   193→  );
   194→
   195→  // Conduit calculation for cameras
   196→  const conduitLength = round2(config.avgDistanceMeters * totalCameras * (1 + factors.wasteFactorConduit));
   197→
   198→  // --- Cameras ---
   199→  for (const cam of config.cameras) {
   200→    const typeLower = cam.type.toLowerCase();
   201→    const keywords: string[] = [];
   202→    if (typeLower.includes("bullet")) keywords.push("bullet");
   203→    else if (typeLower.includes("domo") || typeLower.includes("dome")) keywords.push("domo");
   204→    else if (typeLower.includes("ptz")) keywords.push("ptz");
   205→    else if (typeLower.includes("fisheye")) keywords.push("fisheye");
   206→
   207→    const matched = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CCTV", "Equipo", keywords);
   208→    const unitCost = matched?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cctv_camera_" + typeLower);
   209→
   210→    items.push(
   211→      makeLineItem(
   212→        idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", `CCTV-CAM-${String(idx).padStart(3, "0")}`,
   213→        `Cámara IP ${cam.type} ${cam.hasPoE ? "PoE" : ""} exterior 5MP`,
   214→        "pza", cam.qty, unitCost, "Equipo", !matched
   215→      )
   216→    );
   217→  }
   218→
   219→  // --- NVR ---
   220→  const nvrMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CCTV", "Equipo", ["NVR", "grabador"]);
   221→  const nvrCost = nvrMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cctv_nvr");
   222→  items.push(
   223→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-NVR-001", `NVR ${config.nvr.bays} bahías`, "pza", config.nvr.qty, nvrCost, "Equipo", !nvrMatch)
   224→  );
   225→
   226→  // --- Storage Disks ---
   227→  const totalDisks = config.nvr.bays * config.nvr.disksPerBay;
   228→  const diskMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CCTV", "Equipo", ["disco", "disco duro", "HDD", "almacenamiento"]);
   229→  const diskCost = diskMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cctv_disk");
   230→  if (totalDisks > 0) {
   231→    items.push(
   232→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-DISK-001", `Disco duro ${config.nvr.storageTB}TB para NVR`, "pza", totalDisks, diskCost, "Equipo", !diskMatch)
   233→    );
   234→  }
   235→
   236→  // --- Licenses ---
   237→  if (config.licenses > 0) {
   238→    const licMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CCTV", "Equipo", ["licencia", "license"]);
   239→    const licCost = licMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cctv_license");
   240→    items.push(
   241→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-LIC-001", "Licencia de cámara IP adicional", "pza", config.licenses, licCost, "Equipo", !licMatch)
   242→    );
   243→  }
   244→
   245→  // --- Cable UTP ---
   246→  const cableMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CABLEADO", "Equipo", ["UTP", "cable UTP", "cable Cat"]);
   247→  const cableCost = cableMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cable_utp");
   248→  items.push(
   249→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-CAB-001", "Cable UTP Cat6 para CCTV", "ml", cableLength, cableCost, "Equipo", !cableMatch)
   250→  );
   251→
   252→  // --- Conduit ---
   253→  const conduitMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Equipo", ["conduit", "tubo"]);
   254→  const conduitCost = conduitMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("conduit");
   255→  items.push(
   256→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-CON-001", "Conduit 3/4\" para CCTV", "ml", conduitLength, conduitCost, "Equipo", !conduitMatch)
   257→  );
   258→
   259→  // --- Conduit fittings (codo, cople) ---
   260→  const fittingCount = Math.ceil(conduitLength / 3);
   261→  const codoMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Accesorio", ["codo"]);
   262→  const codoCost = codoMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("codo");
   263→  if (fittingCount > 0) {
   264→    items.push(
   265→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-CODO-001", "Codo conduit 3/4\" 90°", "pza", fittingCount, codoCost, "Accesorio", !codoMatch)
   266→    );
   267→  }
   268→
   269→  const copleMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Accesorio", ["cople"]);
   270→  const copleCost = copleMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cople");
   271→  if (fittingCount > 0) {
   272→    items.push(
   273→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-COPL-001", "Cople conduit 3/4\"", "pza", fittingCount, copleCost, "Accesorio", !copleMatch)
   274→    );
   275→  }
   276→
   277→  // --- Labor ---
   278→  const laborMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CCTV", "Mano de Obra", ["mano de obra", "instalación"]);
   279→  const laborCost = laborMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("labor_cctv");
   280→  items.push(
   281→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.3", "CCTV", "CCTV-MO-001", "Instalación de sistema CCTV (mano de obra)", "lote", 1, laborCost * totalCameras, "Mano de Obra", !laborMatch)
   282→  );
   283→
   284→  const sums = sumLineItems(items);
   285→  return { ...sums, lineItems: items };
   286→}
   287→
   288→export function calculateAccess(
   289→  config: AccessConfig,
   290→  factors: EstimateFactors,
   291→  priceItems: PriceItemRecord[]
   292→): SystemBreakdown {
   293→  const items: LineItem[] = [];
   294→  let idx = 1;
   295→
   296→  const totalDevices = config.doors + config.controllers + config.turnstiles + config.magneticLocks + config.exitButtons + config.touchlessButtons;
   297→
   298→  // Cable
   299→  const cableLength = round2(
   300→    (config.avgDistanceMeters + factors.verticalDrop + factors.rackAllowance) * totalDevices * (1 + factors.wasteFactorCable)
   301→  );
   302→
   303→  // Conduit
   304→  const conduitLength = round2(config.avgDistanceMeters * totalDevices * (1 + factors.wasteFactorConduit));
   305→
   306→  // --- Readers / Terminals ---
   307→  const readerMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Equipo", ["lectora", "terminal", "reconocimiento", "biometrica"]);
   308→  const readerCost = readerMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("access_reader");
   309→  items.push(
   310→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-TER-001", `Terminal de acceso ${config.readerType}`, "pza", config.doors, readerCost, "Equipo", !readerMatch)
   311→  );
   312→
   313→  // --- Controllers ---
   314→  const ctrlMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Equipo", ["controlador"]);
   315→  const ctrlCost = ctrlMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("access_controller");
   316→  items.push(
   317→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-CTR-001", "Controlador de acceso de 2 puertas", "pza", config.controllers, ctrlCost, "Equipo", !ctrlMatch)
   318→  );
   319→
   320→  // --- Turnstiles ---
   321→  if (config.turnstiles > 0) {
   322→    const tsMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Equipo", ["torniquete"]);
   323→    const tsCost = tsMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("access_turnstile");
   324→    items.push(
   325→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-TSR-001", "Torniquete de acceso", "pza", config.turnstiles, tsCost, "Equipo", !tsMatch)
   326→    );
   327→  }
   328→
   329→  // --- Magnetic Locks ---
   330→  const lockMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Equipo", ["cerradura", "chapa", "magnética"]);
   331→  const lockCost = lockMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("access_magnetic_lock");
   332→  items.push(
   333→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-LOC-001", "Cerradura magnética 280kg", "pza", config.magneticLocks, lockCost, "Equipo", !lockMatch)
   334→  );
   335→
   336→  // --- Exit Buttons ---
   337→  if (config.exitButtons > 0) {
   338→    const btnMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Equipo", ["botón", "pulsador"]);
   339→    const btnCost = btnMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("access_exit_button");
   340→    items.push(
   341→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-BTN-001", "Botón de salida", "pza", config.exitButtons, btnCost, "Equipo", !btnMatch)
   342→    );
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  // --- Touchless Buttons ---
   346→  if (config.touchlessButtons > 0) {
   347→    const tlMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Equipo", ["touchless", "sin contacto"]);
   348→    const tlCost = tlMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("access_touchless_button");
   349→    items.push(
   350→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-TLB-001", "Botón sin contacto (touchless)", "pza", config.touchlessButtons, tlCost, "Equipo", !tlMatch)
   351→    );
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  // --- Software Licenses ---
   355→  if (config.softwareLicenses > 0) {
   356→    const swMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Equipo", ["software", "licencia"]);
   357→    const swCost = swMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("access_software");
   358→    items.push(
   359→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-SW-001", "Licencia de software de acceso", "pza", config.softwareLicenses, swCost, "Equipo", !swMatch)
   360→    );
   361→  }
   362→
   363→  // --- Cable ---
   364→  const cableMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CABLEADO", "Equipo", ["UTP", "cable UTP", "cable Cat"]);
   365→  const cableCost = cableMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cable_utp");
   366→  items.push(
   367→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-CAB-001", "Cable UTP Cat6 para control de acceso", "ml", cableLength, cableCost, "Equipo", !cableMatch)
   368→  );
   369→
   370→  // --- Conduit ---
   371→  const conduitMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Equipo", ["conduit", "tubo"]);
   372→  const conduitCost = conduitMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("conduit");
   373→  items.push(
   374→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-CON-001", "Conduit 3/4\" para control de acceso", "ml", conduitLength, conduitCost, "Equipo", !conduitMatch)
   375→  );
   376→
   377→  // --- Conduit fittings ---
   378→  const fittingCount = Math.ceil(conduitLength / 3);
   379→  const codoMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Accesorio", ["codo"]);
   380→  const codoCost = codoMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("codo");
   381→  if (fittingCount > 0) {
   382→    items.push(
   383→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-CODO-001", "Codo conduit 3/4\" 90°", "pza", fittingCount, codoCost, "Accesorio", !codoMatch)
   384→    );
   385→  }
   386→
   387→  // --- Labor ---
   388→  const laborMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "ACCESO", "Mano de Obra", ["mano de obra", "instalación"]);
   389→  const laborCost = laborMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("labor_access");
   390→  items.push(
   391→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.4", "ACCESO", "ACC-MO-001", "Instalación de sistema de control de acceso (mano de obra)", "lote", 1, laborCost * totalDevices, "Mano de Obra", !laborMatch)
   392→  );
   393→
   394→  const sums = sumLineItems(items);
   395→  return { ...sums, lineItems: items };
   396→}
   397→
   398→export function calculatePaging(
   399→  config: PagingConfig,
   400→  factors: EstimateFactors,
   401→  priceItems: PriceItemRecord[]
   402→): SystemBreakdown {
   403→  const items: LineItem[] = [];
   404→  let idx = 1;
   405→
   406→  const totalSpeakers = config.speakers.reduce((s, sp) => s + sp.qty, 0) + config.bluetoothSpeakers;
   407→  const totalDevices = totalSpeakers + config.amplifiers.qty + config.gateways;
   408→
   409→  // Cable
   410→  const cableLength = round2(
   411→    (config.avgDistanceMeters + factors.verticalDrop + factors.rackAllowance) * totalDevices * (1 + factors.wasteFactorCable)
   412→  );
   413→
   414→  // Conduit
   415→  const conduitLength = round2(config.avgDistanceMeters * totalDevices * (1 + factors.wasteFactorConduit));
   416→
   417→  // --- Speakers ---
   418→  for (const sp of config.speakers) {
   419→    const typeLower = sp.type.toLowerCase();
   420→    const keywords: string[] = [];
   421→    if (typeLower.includes("exterior")) keywords.push("exterior", "bafle", "protección");
   422→    else if (typeLower.includes("colgante")) keywords.push("colgante", "techo");
   423→    else if (typeLower.includes("ip")) keywords.push("ip", "altavoz ip");
   424→
   425→    const matched = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "VOCEO", "Equipo", keywords);
   426→    const cost = matched?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("paging_speaker_" + typeLower);
   427→    items.push(
   428→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", `VOC-SPK-${String(idx).padStart(3, "0")}`, `Altavoz ${sp.type} para sistema de voceo`, "pza", sp.qty, cost, "Equipo", !matched)
   429→    );
   430→  }
   431→
   432→  // --- Bluetooth Speakers ---
   433→  if (config.bluetoothSpeakers > 0) {
   434→    const btMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "VOCEO", "Equipo", ["bluetooth", "inalámbrico"]);
   435→    const btCost = btMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("paging_speaker_bluetooth");
   436→    items.push(
   437→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-BT-001", "Altavoz bluetooth", "pza", config.bluetoothSpeakers, btCost, "Equipo", !btMatch)
   438→    );
   439→  }
   440→
   441→  // --- Amplifiers ---
   442→  const ampMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "VOCEO", "Equipo", ["amplificador"]);
   443→  const ampCost = ampMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("paging_amplifier");
   444→  items.push(
   445→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-AMP-001", `Amplificador ${config.amplifiers.watts}W para voceo`, "pza", config.amplifiers.qty, ampCost, "Equipo", !ampMatch)
   446→  );
   447→
   448→  // --- Gateways ---
   449→  const gwMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "VOCEO", "Equipo", ["gateway", "pasarela"]);
   450→  const gwCost = gwMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("paging_gateway");
   451→  items.push(
   452→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-GW-001", "Gateway VoIP para voceo", "pza", config.gateways, gwCost, "Equipo", !gwMatch)
   453→  );
   454→
   455→  // --- Cable ---
   456→  const cableMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CABLEADO", "Equipo", ["UTP", "cable UTP", "cable Cat"]);
   457→  const cableCost = cableMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cable_utp");
   458→  items.push(
   459→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-CAB-001", "Cable UTP Cat6 para voceo", "ml", cableLength, cableCost, "Equipo", !cableMatch)
   460→  );
   461→
   462→  // --- Speaker wire (alternating) ---
   463→  const speakerWireLength = round2(cableLength * 0.5); // speaker wire only for analog portions
   464→  const spkWireMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CABLEADO", "Equipo", ["parlante", "altavoz", "bocina", "speaker wire"]);
   465→  const spkWireCost = spkWireMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cable_speaker");
   466→  items.push(
   467→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-SWK-001", "Cable para altavoz", "ml", speakerWireLength, spkWireCost, "Equipo", !spkWireMatch)
   468→  );
   469→
   470→  // --- Conduit ---
   471→  const conduitMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Equipo", ["conduit", "tubo"]);
   472→  const conduitCost = conduitMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("conduit");
   473→  items.push(
   474→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-CON-001", "Conduit 3/4\" para voceo", "ml", conduitLength, conduitCost, "Equipo", !conduitMatch)
   475→  );
   476→
   477→  // --- Conduit fittings ---
   478→  const fittingCount = Math.ceil(conduitLength / 3);
   479→  const codoMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Accesorio", ["codo"]);
   480→  const codoCost = codoMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("codo");
   481→  if (fittingCount > 0) {
   482→    items.push(
   483→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-CODO-001", "Codo conduit 3/4\" 90°", "pza", fittingCount, codoCost, "Accesorio", !codoMatch)
   484→    );
   485→  }
   486→
   487→  // --- Labor ---
   488→  const laborMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "VOCEO", "Mano de Obra", ["mano de obra", "instalación"]);
   489→  const laborCost = laborMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("labor_paging");
   490→  items.push(
   491→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.5", "VOCEO", "VOC-MO-001", "Instalación de sistema de voceo (mano de obra)", "lote", 1, laborCost * totalDevices, "Mano de Obra", !laborMatch)
   492→  );
   493→
   494→  const sums = sumLineItems(items);
   495→  return { ...sums, lineItems: items };
   496→}
   497→
   498→export function calculateFire(
   499→  config: FireConfig,
   500→  factors: EstimateFactors,
   501→  priceItems: PriceItemRecord[]
   502→): SystemBreakdown {
   503→  const items: LineItem[] = [];
   504→  let idx = 1;
   505→
   506→  const totalDevices =
   507→    config.smokeDetectors +
   508→    config.heatDetectors +
   509→    config.manualStations +
   510→    config.strobes +
   511→    config.hornStrobes +
   512→    config.coDetectors;
   513→
   514→  // Cable
   515→  const cableLength = round2(
   516→    (config.avgDistanceMeters + factors.verticalDrop + factors.rackAllowance) * totalDevices * (1 + factors.wasteFactorCable)
   517→  );
   518→
   519→  // Conduit
   520→  const conduitLength = round2(config.avgDistanceMeters * totalDevices * (1 + factors.wasteFactorConduit));
   521→
   522→  // --- Smoke Detectors ---
   523→  if (config.smokeDetectors > 0) {
   524→    const match = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["humo", "detector", "smoke"]);
   525→    const cost = match?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_smoke_detector");
   526→    items.push(
   527→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-SMK-001", "Detector de humo fotoeléctrico", "pza", config.smokeDetectors, cost, "Equipo", !match)
   528→    );
   529→  }
   530→
   531→  // --- Heat Detectors ---
   532→  if (config.heatDetectors > 0) {
   533→    const match = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["temperatura", "calor", "heat"]);
   534→    const cost = match?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_heat_detector");
   535→    items.push(
   536→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-HEAT-001", "Detector de temperatura", "pza", config.heatDetectors, cost, "Equipo", !match)
   537→    );
   538→  }
   539→
   540→  // --- Manual Stations ---
   541→  if (config.manualStations > 0) {
   542→    const match = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["estación manual", "pulsador", "manual"]);
   543→    const cost = match?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_manual_station");
   544→    items.push(
   545→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-MS-001", "Estación manual de alarma", "pza", config.manualStations, cost, "Equipo", !match)
   546→    );
   547→  }
   548→
   549→  // --- Strobes ---
   550→  if (config.strobes > 0) {
   551→    const match = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["estroboscópica", "estrobo", "strobe"]);
   552→    const cost = match?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_strobe");
   553→    items.push(
   554→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-STR-001", "Lámpara estroboscópica", "pza", config.strobes, cost, "Equipo", !match)
   555→    );
   556→  }
   557→
   558→  // --- Horn Strobes ---
   559→  if (config.hornStrobes > 0) {
   560→    const match = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["horn strobe", "campana", "sirena"]);
   561→    const cost = match?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_horn_strobe");
   562→    items.push(
   563→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-HS-001", "Dispositivo audible/visible (horn strobe)", "pza", config.hornStrobes, cost, "Equipo", !match)
   564→    );
   565→  }
   566→
   567→  // --- CO Detectors ---
   568→  if (config.coDetectors > 0) {
   569→    const match = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["CO", "monóxido", "carbono"]);
   570→    const cost = match?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_co_detector");
   571→    items.push(
   572→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-CO-001", "Detector de monóxido de carbono", "pza", config.coDetectors, cost, "Equipo", !match)
   573→    );
   574→  }
   575→
   576→  // --- Panels ---
   577→  const panelMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["panel", "central"]);
   578→  const panelCost = panelMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_panel");
   579→  items.push(
   580→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-PNL-001", `Panel de alarma contra incendio ${config.panels.loops} lazos`, "pza", config.panels.qty, panelCost, "Equipo", !panelMatch)
   581→  );
   582→
   583→  // --- Annunciators ---
   584→  if (config.annunciators > 0) {
   585→    const annMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Equipo", ["anunciador", "indicador"]);
   586→    const annCost = annMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("fire_annunciator");
   587→    items.push(
   588→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-ANN-001", "Anunciador remoto", "pza", config.annunciators, annCost, "Equipo", !annMatch)
   589→    );
   590→  }
   591→
   592→  // --- Cable FPLR ---
   593→  const fplrMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CABLEADO", "Equipo", ["FPLR", "fire", "incendio", "resistente al fuego"]);
   594→  const fplrCost = fplrMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("cable_fplr");
   595→  items.push(
   596→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-CAB-001", "Cable FPLR para sistema contra incendio", "ml", cableLength, fplrCost, "Equipo", !fplrMatch)
   597→  );
   598→
   599→  // --- Conduit ---
   600→  const conduitMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Equipo", ["conduit", "tubo"]);
   601→  const conduitCost = conduitMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("conduit");
   602→  items.push(
   603→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-CON-001", "Conduit 3/4\" para sistema contra incendio", "ml", conduitLength, conduitCost, "Equipo", !conduitMatch)
   604→  );
   605→
   606→  // --- Conduit fittings ---
   607→  const fittingCount = Math.ceil(conduitLength / 3);
   608→  const codoMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "CANALIZACION", "Accesorio", ["codo"]);
   609→  const codoCost = codoMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("codo");
   610→  if (fittingCount > 0) {
   611→    items.push(
   612→      makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-CODO-001", "Codo conduit 3/4\" 90°", "pza", fittingCount, codoCost, "Accesorio", !codoMatch)
   613→    );
   614→  }
   615→
   616→  // --- Labor ---
   617→  const laborMatch = matchPriceItem(priceItems, "INCENDIO", "Mano de Obra", ["mano de obra", "instalación"]);
   618→  const laborCost = laborMatch?.unitCost ?? getEstimatedCost("labor_fire");
   619→  items.push(
   620→    makeLineItem(idx++, "5.7.6", "INCENDIO", "FIR-MO-001", "Instalación de sistema contra incendio (mano de obra)", "lote", 1, laborCost * totalDevices, "Mano de Obra", !laborMatch)
   621→  );
   622→
   623→  const sums = sumLineItems(items);
   624→  return { ...sums, lineItems: items };
   625→}
   626→
   627→// ─── Estimated costs (fallback when no DB match) ────────────────────────────
   628→
   629→function getEstimatedCost(key: string): number {
   630→  const costs: Record<string, number> = {
   631→    cctv_camera_bullet: 7805.18,
   632→    cctv_camera_domo: 8210.45,
   633→    cctv_camera_ptz: 28500.0,
   634→    cctv_camera_fisheye: 15200.0,
   635→    cctv_nvr: 45600.0,
   636→    cctv_disk: 5200.0,
   637→    cctv_license: 850.0,
   638→    cable_utp: 28.5,
   639→    cable_fplr: 42.0,
   640→    cable_speaker: 18.0,
   641→    conduit: 38.5,
   642→    codo: 15.0,
   643→    cople: 12.0,
   644→    conector: 22.0,
   645→    soporte: 65.0,
   646→    caja: 185.0,
   647→    tapa: 95.0,
   648→    flexible_plica: 45.0,
   649→    labor_cctv: 450.0,
   650→    labor_access: 380.0,
   651→    labor_paging: 350.0,
   652→    labor_fire: 420.0,
   653→    access_reader: 9800.0,
   654→    access_controller: 12500.0,
   655→    access_turnstile: 35000.0,
   656→    access_magnetic_lock: 2850.0,
   657→    access_exit_button: 285.0,
   658→    access_touchless_button: 650.0,
   659→    access_software: 2200.0,
   660→    paging_speaker_exterior: 3200.0,
   661→    paging_speaker_colgante: 2800.0,
   662→    paging_speaker_ip: 5500.0,
   663→    paging_speaker_bluetooth: 4200.0,
   664→    paging_amplifier: 8500.0,
   665→    paging_gateway: 12000.0,
   666→    fire_smoke_detector: 1450.0,
   667→    fire_heat_detector: 1200.0,
   668→    fire_manual_station: 680.0,
   669→    fire_strobe: 850.0,
   670→    fire_horn_strobe: 1150.0,
   671→    fire_co_detector: 2800.0,
   672→    fire_panel: 68000.0,
   673→    fire_annunciator: 8500.0,
   674→  };
   675→  return costs[key] ?? 1000.0;
   676→}
   677→
   678→// ─── Main Calculation Function ───────────────────────────────────────────────
   679→
   680→export function runCalculation(params: {
   681→  cctvConfig?: CctvConfig;
   682→  accessConfig?: AccessConfig;
   683→  pagingConfig?: PagingConfig;
   684→  fireConfig?: FireConfig;
   685→  factors: EstimateFactors;
   686→  priceItems: PriceItemRecord[];
   687→}): CalculationResult {
   688→  const { cctvConfig, accessConfig, pagingConfig, fireConfig, factors, priceItems } = params;
   689→
   690→  const systems: Record<string, SystemBreakdown> = {};
   691→  const allLineItems: LineItem[] = [];
   692→
   693→  if (cctvConfig && cctvConfig.cameras?.length > 0) {
   694→    systems["CCTV"] = calculateCCTV(cctvConfig, factors, priceItems);
   695→    allLineItems.push(...systems["CCTV"].lineItems);
   696→  }
   697→
   698→  if (accessConfig && accessConfig.doors > 0) {
   699→    systems["ACCESO"] = calculateAccess(accessConfig, factors, priceItems);
   700→    allLineItems.push(...systems["ACCESO"].lineItems);
   701→  }
   702→
   703→  if (pagingConfig && (pagingConfig.speakers?.length > 0 || pagingConfig.bluetoothSpeakers > 0)) {
   704→    systems["VOCEO"] = calculatePaging(pagingConfig, factors, priceItems);
   705→    allLineItems.push(...systems["VOCEO"].lineItems);
   706→  }
   707→
   708→  if (fireConfig && (fireConfig.smokeDetectors > 0 || fireConfig.heatDetectors > 0 || fireConfig.manualStations > 0)) {
   709→    systems["INCENDIO"] = calculateFire(fireConfig, factors, priceItems);
   710→    allLineItems.push(...systems["INCENDIO"].lineItems);
   711→  }
   712→
   713→  // Add general/service items from price items
   714→  const serviceItems = priceItems.filter(
   715→    (pi) => pi.system === "GENERAL" && pi.category === "Servicio" && pi.active
   716→  );
   717→  const generalLineItems: LineItem[] = [];
   718→  serviceItems.forEach((si, i) => {
   719→    generalLineItems.push(
   720→      makeLineItem(
   721→        i + 1, "5.7.0", "GENERAL", `SRV-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
   722→        si.description, si.unit, 1, si.unitCost, "Servicio"
   723→      )
   724→    );
   725→  });
   726→  if (generalLineItems.length > 0) {
   727→    systems["GENERAL"] = { ...sumLineItems(generalLineItems), lineItems: generalLineItems };
   728→    allLineItems.push(...generalLineItems);
   729→  }
   730→
   731→  const subtotalMaterials = round2(allLineItems.filter((i) => i.category === "Equipo" || i.category === "Accesorio" || i.category === "Consumible").reduce((s, i) => s + i.totalAmount, 0));
   732→  const subtotalLabor = round2(allLineItems.filter((i) => i.category === "Mano de Obra").reduce((s, i) => s + i.totalAmount, 0));
   733→  const subtotalEngineering = round2(allLineItems.filter((i) => i.category === "Ingeniería").reduce((s, i) => s + i.totalAmount, 0));
   734→  const subtotalServices = round2(allLineItems.filter((i) => i.category === "Servicio").reduce((s, i) => s + i.totalAmount, 0));
   735→
   736→  const subtotalDirect = round2(subtotalMaterials + subtotalLabor + subtotalEngineering + subtotalServices);
   737→  const subtotalIndirects = round2(subtotalDirect * factors.indirectFactor);
   738→  const subtotalUtility = round2((subtotalDirect + subtotalIndirects) * factors.utilityFactor);
   739→  const grandTotal = round2(subtotalDirect + subtotalIndirects + subtotalUtility);
   740→
   741→  return {
   742→    systems,
   743→    subtotalMaterials,
   744→    subtotalLabor,
   745→    subtotalEngineering,
   746→    subtotalServices,
   747→    subtotalDirect,
   748→    subtotalIndirects,
   749→    subtotalUtility,
   750→    grandTotal,
   751→    lineItems: allLineItems,
   752→  };
   753→}
